description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called CustomerSearchFilterParams used within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties and methods to manage search filter parameters for customer data, specifically 'name' and 'customerIds', along with sorting capabilities.

classes.name: CustomerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to customers in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets a default sort field to 'customer.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the customer name filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the customer name filter parameter.

methods.name: getCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns the array of customer IDs filter parameter.

methods.name: setCustomerIds
methods.description: Sets the array of customer IDs filter parameter.
